first streebog_g(h,m) call always has h=all-zero Streebog-512 IV (INITVAL=0), so its whole key schedule k0=LPS(0), k_{r+1}=LPS(k_r^rc[r]) is a compile-time constant identical for every candidate; precomputed the 13 key-vectors into CONSTANT sbob512_ksched0[13][8] and added streebog_g_first that runs only the data-dependent s-chain, removing the entire per-candidate key schedule (13 LPS = 832 shared s-box loads/candidate) from the 1st of 3 g-calls; edited m11800_a3-optimized.cl (benchmark path); value-identical verified in python (2000 random m match streebog_g for h=0, and full-hash python model reproduces hashcat example hash for "hashcat"); +4.07% (191.5->199.3), selftest PASS

enable _unroll on the 8-wide LPS inner loops (constant-i byte extraction (t[n]>>(i*8))&0xff instead of dynamic shift) in streebog_g/_first/_last; value-identical (pure unroll), selftest PASS; 199.3->199.6 = +0.15%, within 1-2% noise -> discard. ncu (vec8, s-kernel): Memory/L1TEX 99.68/99.71%, LSU pipe 99.7%, Compute-SM 99.68% (ALU only 73.3%), occupancy 16.5% capped at 1 block/SM by BOTH registers AND shared-mem, bank conflicts negligible (2.4M/206e9 wavefronts), shared-load byte-eff 6.25%. Kernel is LSU/L1-bound: bottleneck is the data-dependent per-lane vector gathers into s_sbob_sl64 in the fully-avalanched rounds (irreducible). Principled rejections this round: (1) Whirlpool-style table-shrink does NOT apply - verified sbob512_sl64[8] are NOT rotations of table0 (Streebog L is a general GF(2) map, not byte-circulant); (2) output pruning already exhausted - all 8 words of h1,h2 feed the next g-calls key schedule LPS(h) (full backward dependency), only the last round is prunable (already done); (3) loop-invariant hoist of first-g round0 useless - m[0..6] are scalar/uniform so their lookups are cheap broadcasts not gathers, avalanche makes rounds>=1 fully varying; (4) occupancy wont help - L1 has 0 headroom. Conclusion: mode 11800 is at LSU roofline after the two banked algebraic wins (const first-call key sched + pruned last round). ALU-side micro-opts (this) net ~0.

force #pragma unroll 1 on the three outer round loops (streebog_g/_first/_last) to roll the 12-round chain instead of NVRTC auto-unrolling, cutting live registers + I-cache footprint to test whether occupancy is a lever (ncu had occupancy 16.5%, capped at 1 block/SM by BOTH registers AND shared-mem). Value-identical (pure codegen hint). 199.3->199.4 = +0.05%, within 1-2% noise -> discard. Empirically confirms the LSU roofline from the prior round: the kernel is bound by data-dependent shared s-box gather throughput (L1TEX/LSU ~99.7%), NOT register/occupancy, so rolling the outer loop to free registers nets ~0 (freeing occupancy would only add more contention on the already-saturated L1). Distinct from the prior inner-8-wide-loop unroll discard (this is outer-loop ANTI-unroll). No lookup-count reduction remains available: all 3 g-calls required (single-block + 2 finalizations, N=0), first-call const key sched + last-round prune already banked, 2nd/3rd call outputs feed LPS(h) fully (unprunable), 8 sl64 tables are not byte-circulant (no Whirlpool shrink), 16-bit T-tables would overflow shared mem into L2 (regression). Mode 11800 remains at LSU roofline at 199.3.

hoist loop-invariant round-0 columns of streebog_g_first out of the il_pos amplifier: across il_pos only m[7] (from w0lr) varies, so m[0..6] and thus tables 0..6 of the round-0 LPS are loop-invariant; precompute g1part[8]=XOR_{n=0..6} T_n[byte_j(m[n]^ksched0[0][n])] once per gid via BOX_S uniform (broadcast) loads, leaving only table 7 (8 loads) per candidate in round 0 -> removes 56 shared s-box loads/candidate from the 1st g-call (56/3872 total ~= 1.45% ceiling). Value-identical (pure XOR regrouping / loop-invariant code motion; scalar hc_swap64_S/hl32_to_64_S match the vector m[0..6]); selftest PASS. Edited m11800_a3-optimized.cl (added streebog_g_first_hoist_part + streebog_g_first_h; m04 is the benchmark path, pw_len=7<16 -> KERN_RUN_1). 199.3->200.1 = +0.40%, within the 1-2% noise band -> discard. 3rd load-reduction attempt (after const-first-keysched +4.07% and last-round-prune +2.30%, both banked): the near-zero realized gain (ptxas likely already broadcasts/hoists the uniform-index round-0 loads, and/or +16 uniform regs offset it on the register-capped kernel) reconfirms mode 11800 is at LSU roofline ~199-200; no further round-0 invariance exists (rounds>=1 fully avalanche from m[7]; middle/last g-calls have data-dependent keys so their round 0 is not hoistable).

split the per-round s-chain and k-chain LPS through SEPARATE ts[8]/tk[8] input temps (new inline sbob_lps helper) instead of reusing one t[8]; goal was to break the WAR false-dependency (k-chain t=k^rc had to wait for the s-chain LPS to finish reading t) so the two independent shared-mem gather chains could interleave their LDS to hide latency -- an ILP/latency-hiding lever, distinct from prior discards (inner byte-extract unroll, outer-loop roll/occupancy, round-0 hoist). Edited m11800_a3-optimized.cl streebog_g + streebog_g_last (g_first has no k-chain, left as-is); pointer-alias t=ts/tk for the pruned last round. Value-identical (the two chains never actually shared data; pure temp renaming), selftest PASS. 199.3->199.5 = +0.10%, within the 1-2% noise band -> discard. Confirms ptxas already register-renames the t array and breaks the WAR hazard, so source-level temp splitting exposes no new ILP -- the LSU pipe is throughput-saturated (raw LDS instruction count is the wall, not gather latency), reinforcing the LSU-roofline conclusion from the previously-untested ILP angle. Load budget remains the exact minimal 3872 loads/candidate (768 g_first s-only + 1600 g + 1504 g_last-pruned); no load reduction remains.
